To locate the patient record before booking an appointment, search the server for the given name and family name combination.
<tool_call>
{"name": "computer_use", "arguments": {"action": "type", "coordinate": [204, 32], "text": "Tomasz Wren", "press_enter": true, "delete_existing_text": true}}
</tool_call>

Open the patient record to verify details and later book an appointment
<tool_call>
{"name": "computer_use", "arguments": {"action": "left_click", "coordinate": [222, 302]}}
</tool_call>

To create a new appointment, navigate to the FHIR 'Appointment' resource using the 'JSON' tab of the patient's context menu.
<tool_call>
{"name": "computer_use", "arguments": {"action": "left_click", "coordinate": [475, 152]}}
</tool_call>

Close the JSON modal to return to the patient record so I can access the 'Appointments' section in the navigation
<tool_call>
{"name": "computer_use", "arguments": {"action": "left_click", "coordinate": [1067, 747]}}
</tool_call>

Close the JSON modal to return to the patient record so I can access the 'Appointments' section
<tool_call>
{"name": "computer_use", "arguments": {"action": "left_click", "coordinate": [1067, 747]}}
</tool_call>

The JSON modal is stuck and blocking navigation, so directly navigate to the patient's appointments history using the known ID and FHIR endpoint
<tool_call>
{"name": "computer_use", "arguments": {"action": "visit_url", "url": "http://localhost:9821/Patient/c1878b98-1a41-403d-81d6-60eb3eb3640d/appointments"}}
</tool_call>

The patient's appointments endpoint is not rendering any results; to locate an existing appointment, search the server for the appointment ID
<tool_call>
{"name": "computer_use", "arguments": {"action": "type", "coordinate": [204, 32], "text": "Appointment/12345", "press_enter": true, "delete_existing_text": true}}
</tool_call>

The patient's appointments endpoint is not rendering results; directly navigate to the FHIR Appointment search URL with the patient query to find any existing appointment
<tool_call>
{"name": "computer_use", "arguments": {"action": "visit_url", "url": "http://localhost:9821/search?_type=Appointment&patient=$patient_id"}}
</tool_call>

The search results are still loading (spinner visible); wait a few seconds for the results to load before interacting
<tool_call>
{"name": "computer_use", "arguments": {"action": "wait", "time": 3}}
</tool_call>

The search results are still loading (spinner visible); wait another few seconds for the results to load before interacting
<tool_call>
{"name": "computer_use", "arguments": {"action": "wait", "time": 3}}
</tool_call>

The search results are stuck loading with a spinner; reload the search results page to clear the stuck state
<tool_call>
{"name": "computer_use", "arguments": {"action": "visit_url", "url": "http://localhost:9821/search?_count=20&_fields=id,_lastUpdated&_sort=-_lastUpdated&_type=Appointment"}}
</tool_call>

The search results are stuck on a loading spinner; reload the appointments endpoint for the specific patient to load any existing appointment records
<tool_call>
{"name": "computer_use", "arguments": {"action": "visit_url", "url": "http://localhost:9821/Patient/c1878b98-1a41-403d-81d6-60eb3eb3640d/appointments"}}
</tool_call>
